originalSource:
onNativeclientSocket: aNativeSocket for: aServerSocket
  "^self
	I initialize myself with the same properties as aServerSocket and with
	aNativeSocket as my underlying socket."

  communicationDomain := aServerSocket communicationDomain.
  socketType := aServerSocket socketType.
  protocolNumber := aServerSocket protocolNumber.
  self _setNoStubbing.	"as long as I am in memory prevent stubbing of my instance variables ... I will stay in memory as long as I am referenced from stack.."
  underlyingSocket := TransientStackValue value: aNativeSocket.	"if I am committed, then do not persist aNativeSocket"
  ^ self

onNativeSocket: aSocket forDomain: aCommunicationDomain type: aSocketType protocol: aProtocolNumber
  "^self
	I initialize myself as a socket defined by the communications domain, type and protocol.  This
	follows the equivalent of the using the socket()  or socketpair() function."

  communicationDomain := aCommunicationDomain.
  socketType := aSocketType.
  protocolNumber := aProtocolNumber.
  self _setNoStubbing.	"as long as I am in memory prevent stubbing of my instance variables ... I will stay in memory as long as I am referenced from stack.."
  underlyingSocket := TransientStackValue value: aSocket.	"if I am committed, then do not persist aSocket"
  ^ self

nativeOperation: block
 ^ [ block value ] on: SocketError do: [ :error | self socketFailure: error description ]

socketFailure: message
 | native symbol |
 native := self underlyingSocket.
 symbol := native ifNotNil: [ [ native lastErrorSymbol ] on: SocketError do: [ :ignored | nil ] ].
 self close.
 symbol == #TimedOut ifTrue: [ ConnectionTimedOut signal: message ].
 (#(BrokenPipe ConnReset ConnAborted NotConnected Shutdown NetworkReset) includes: symbol)
  ifTrue: [ ConnectionClosed signal: message ].
 NetworkError signal: message

close
 | native |
 native := self underlyingSocket.
 native ifNotNil: [ [ native close ] on: SocketError do: [ :error | nil ] ].
 ^ self

closeAndDestroy
 ^ self close

isActive
 ^ self underlyingSocket notNil and: [ self underlyingSocket isActive == true ]

isConnected
 | result |
 self isActive ifFalse: [ ^ false ].
 result := self nativeOperation: [ self underlyingSocket isConnected ].
 result ifNil: [ self socketFailure: 'Cannot determine connection state' ].
 ^ result

 | result milliseconds |
 "Timeout is seconds; -1 means indefinite. Native name resolution has no timeout guarantee."
 milliseconds := seconds < 0 ifTrue: [ -1 ] ifFalse: [ (seconds * 1000) truncated ].
 [ result := self nativeOperation: [ self underlyingSocket connectTo: port on: host timeoutMs: milliseconds ].

  (milliseconds >= 0 and: [ self underlyingSocket lastErrorSymbol == #InProgress ])
   ifTrue: [ self close. ConnectionTimedOut signal: 'Socket connection timed out' ].
  self socketFailure: 'Socket connection failed' ] ]
  on: Exception do: [ :error | self close. error pass ].

originalSource:
accept
  "^an SpSocket
	I accept the next connection made to the server socket I represent.  I return a new
	instance of SpSocket which represents the socket over which information can be
	exchanged.
	NOTE: this call will block waiting for an inbound connection"

  | gsSocket |
  gsSocket := self underlyingSocket accept.
  gsSocket
    ifNil: [ 
      NetworkError
        signal:
          'accept error: ' , self underlyingSocket lastErrorString asString ].
  ^ SocketStreamSocket onNativeclientSocket: gsSocket for: self

source:
accept: seconds
 | native milliseconds symbol |
 "Seconds; -1 indefinite. A finite readiness wait is followed by nonblocking native accept with zero milliseconds, so disappeared readiness never falls into indefinite accept."
 milliseconds := seconds < 0 ifTrue: [ -1 ] ifFalse: [ (seconds * 1000) truncated ].
 native := milliseconds < 0
  ifTrue: [ self nativeOperation: [ self underlyingSocket accept ] ]
  ifFalse: [
   self isActive ifFalse: [ self socketFailure: 'Cannot accept on a closed listener' ].
   self setOption: 'NONBLOCKING' value: true.
   (self waitForReadDataUpToMs: milliseconds) ifFalse: [
    self isActive ifFalse: [ self socketFailure: 'Listener closed while waiting to accept' ].
    ^ nil ].
   self nativeOperation: [ self underlyingSocket acceptTimeoutMs: 0 ] ].
 native ifNil: [
  symbol := self nativeOperation: [ self underlyingSocket lastErrorSymbol ].
  self isActive ifFalse: [ self socketFailure: 'Listener closed while accepting' ].
  (milliseconds >= 0 and: [ symbol isNil or: [ #(WouldBlock TryAgain TimedOut) includes: symbol ] ])
   ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
  self socketFailure: 'Socket accept failed' ].
 ^ [ self class onNativeclientSocket: native for: self ]
  on: Exception do: [ :error | [ native close ] on: SocketError do: [ :ignored | nil ]. error pass ]

accept: aTimeout
  "^an SpSocket
	I accept the next connection made to the server socket I represent.  I return a new
	instance of SpSocket which represents the socket over which information can be
	exchanged.
	NOTE: this call will block waiting for an inbound connection"

  | gsSocket |
  gsSocket := self underlyingSocket accept: aTimeout.
  gsSocket
    ifNil: [ NetworkError signal: 'accept error: ' , self underlyingSocket lastErrorString ].
  ^ SocketStreamSocket onNativeclientSocket: gsSocket for: self

receiveAvailableDataInto: buffer startingAt: start
 | position count |
 position := start.
 [ position <= buffer size and: [ self dataAvailable ] ] whileTrue: [
  count := self receiveSomeDataInto: buffer startingAt: position.
  count = 0 ifTrue: [ ^ position - start ].
  position := position + count ].

originalSource:
receiveAvailableDataInto: buffer startingAt: startIndex
	"Receive all available data into the given buffer and return the number of bytes received.
	Note the given buffer may be only partially filled by the received data.
	Do not wait for data."

	| bufferPos bytesRead |
	bufferPos := startIndex.
	[self dataAvailable
		and: [bufferPos-1 < buffer size]] 
		whileTrue: [
			bytesRead := self receiveSomeDataInto: buffer startingAt: bufferPos.
			bufferPos := bufferPos + bytesRead].
	^bufferPos - startIndex

receiveDataInto: aStringOrByteArray startingAt: aNumber
	"Receive data into the given buffer and return the number of bytes received. 
	Note the given buffer may be only partially filled by the received data.
	Waits for data once.  The answer may be zero (indicating that no data was 
	available before the socket closed)."

	| bytesRead closed b |
	bytesRead := 0.
	closed := false.
	[closed not and: [bytesRead == 0]]
		whileTrue: [self waitForDataIfClosed: [closed := true].
			b:=(aStringOrByteArray size  -aNumber +1).
		
			bytesRead := self  readInto: aStringOrByteArray startingAt: aNumber for: b  ].
		
	^bytesRead

receiveDataSignallingClosedInto: aStringOrByteArray startingAt: aNumber
	"Receive data into the given buffer and return the number of bytes received. 
	Note the given buffer may be only partially filled by the received data.
	Waits for data until something is read or the socket is closed, upon which
	we signal."

	| bytesRead |
	bytesRead := 0.
	[bytesRead == 0]
		whileTrue: [
			self waitForData.
			bytesRead := self  readInto: aStringOrByteArray startingAt: aNumber for: (aStringOrByteArray size  -aNumber +1) ].
	^bytesRead

	Note the given buffer may be only partially filled by the received data.
	Wait for data once for the specified nr of seconds.  The answer may be 
	zero (indicating that there was no data available within the given timeout)."

waitForDataFor: seconds ifClosed: closedBlock ifTimedOut: timedOutBlock
 | milliseconds |
 self isConnected ifFalse: [ self close. ^ closedBlock value ].
 milliseconds := seconds < 0 ifTrue: [ -1 ] ifFalse: [ (seconds * 1000) truncated ].
 (self waitForReadDataUpToMs: milliseconds) ifTrue: [ ^ self ].
 self isConnected ifFalse: [ self close. ^ closedBlock value ].

originalSource:
waitForDataFor: timeout ifClosed: closedBlock ifTimedOut: timedOutBlock
  "Wait for the given nr of seconds for data to arrive."

  | startTime msecsDelta |
  startTime := Time millisecondClockValue.
  msecsDelta := (timeout * 1000) truncated.
  [ (Time millisecondsSince: startTime) < msecsDelta ]
    whileTrue: [ 
      self readyForRead
        ifTrue: [ ^ self ].
      self isConnected
        ifFalse: [ ^ closedBlock value ].
      self
        waitForNonBlockingReadActivityUpToMs:
          (msecsDelta - (Time millisecondsSince: startTime) max: 0) ].
  self readyForRead
    ifFalse: [ 
      self isConnected
        ifTrue: [ ^ timedOutBlock value ]
        ifFalse: [ ^ closedBlock value ] ]

originalSource:
waitForDataIfClosed: closedBlock
	"Wait indefinitely for data to arrive.  This method will block until
	data is available or the socket is closed."

	[true]
		whileTrue: [
			self isConnected
				ifFalse: [^closedBlock value].
			(self readyForRead)
				ifTrue: [
					^self].

			self underlyingSocket readWillNotBlockWithin: -1].

flushComet
  "Flushes the receiver and answer if the socket is still in a valid state and both ends are properly connected. Free the socket, as a side-effect if there is a problem."

  | result |
  result := [ 
  self flush.
  true ]
    on: NetworkError
    do: [ :err | false ].
  result := result and: [ self isConnected and: [ self isOtherEndConnected ] ].
  result
    ifFalse: [ self socket destroy ].
  ^ result

	| stream address |
	address := url host. 
	stream := (self streamClassForScheme: url scheme) 
		openConnectionToHost: address
		port: url portOrDefault
		timeout: self timeout.	
	self setSocketStreamParameters: stream.	
	(#(https wss) includes: url scheme)
		ifTrue:
			[stream

				perform: #serverNameIndication:
				with: url host.
			stream
				connect].	
	^ stream

source:
httpGetDocument: url args: args accept: mimeType request: requestString
	"Return the exact contents of a web object. Asks for the given MIME type. If mimeType is nil, use 'text/html'. An extra requestString may be  submitted and must end with crlf.  The parsed header is saved. Use a proxy server if one has been registered.  tk 7/23/97 17:12"
	"Note: To fetch raw data, you can use the MIME type 'application/octet-stream'."

	| serverName serverAddr port bare page index connectToHost connectToPort aStream portSuffix |
	bare := (url asLowercase beginsWith: 'http://') 
				ifTrue: [url copyFrom: 8 to: url size]
				ifFalse: [url].
	bare := bare copyUpTo: $#.  "remove fragment, if specified"
	serverName := bare copyUpTo: $/.
	page := bare copyFrom: serverName size + 1 to: bare size.
	(serverName includes: $:) 
		ifTrue:
			[index := serverName indexOf: $:.
			port := (serverName copyFrom: index+1 to: serverName size) asNumber.
			portSuffix := ':', port printString.
			serverName := serverName copyFrom: 1 to: index-1. ]
		ifFalse: [ 
			port := self defaultPort.
			portSuffix := ''].
	page size = 0 ifTrue: [page := '/'].
	"add arguments"
	args ifNotNil: [page := page, (self argString: args) ].

	(self shouldUseProxy: serverName)
		ifFalse: 
			[connectToHost := serverName.
			connectToPort := port ]
		ifTrue:
			[page := 'http://', serverName, portSuffix, page. "put back together"
			connectToHost := self httpProxyServer.
			connectToPort := self httpProxyPort].
	
	serverAddr := GsSocket getHostAddressByName: connectToHost.
	serverAddr ifNil: [^ 'Could not resolve the server named: ', connectToHost].

	3 timesRepeat: [ | sock header firstData newUrl list length type |
		sock := HTTPSocket connectToServerOnHost: connectToHost port: connectToPort .
		[ sock sendCommand: 'GET ', page, ' HTTP/1.0', String crlf, 
			(mimeType ifNotNil: ['ACCEPT: ', mimeType,  String crlf] ifNil: ['']),
			'ACCEPT: text/html',  String crlf,	"Always accept plain text"
			HTTPProxyCredentials,
			HTTPBlabEmail,	"may be empty"
			requestString,	"extra user request. Authorization"
			self userAgentString,  String crlf,
			'Host: ', serverName, portSuffix,  String crlf.	"blank line automatically added"

		list := sock getResponseUpTo: String crlf, String crlf ignoring: (String with: Character cr). "list = header, CrLf, CrLf, beginningOfData"
		header := list at: 1.
		firstData := list at: 3.
		header isEmpty 
			ifTrue: [aStream := 'server aborted early']
			ifFalse: [
				"dig out some headers"
				sock header: header.
				length := sock getHeader: 'content-length'.
				length ifNotNil: [ length := length asNumber ].
				type := sock getHeader: 'content-type'.
				sock responseCode first = $3 ifTrue: [
					newUrl := sock getHeader: 'location'.
					newUrl ifNotNil: [ 
						Transcript show: 'redirecting to ', newUrl; cr.
						sock closeAndDestroy.
						newUrl := self expandUrl: newUrl ip: serverAddr port: connectToPort.
						^self httpGetDocument: newUrl args: args  accept: mimeType request: requestString] ].
			aStream := sock getRestOfBuffer: firstData totalLength: length.
			"a 400-series error"
			sock responseCode first = $4 ifTrue: [^ header, aStream contents].
			].
	sock closeAndDestroy.	"Always OK to destroy!"
	aStream class ~~ String ifTrue: [
 		^ MIMEDocument contentType: type content: aStream contents url: url].
	aStream = 'server aborted early' ifTrue: [ ^aStream ].
 ] ensure: [ sock closeAndDestroy ].
	].

	{'HTTPSocket class>>httpGetDocument:args:accept:request:'. aStream. url} inspect.
	^'some other bad thing happened!'

getResponseUpTo: marker
 ^ self getResponseUpTo: marker ignoring: ''
originalSource:
getResponseUpTo: markerString
	"Keep reading until the marker is seen.  Return three parts: header, marker, beginningOfData.  Fails if no marker in first 2000 chars." 

	| buf response bytesRead tester mm tries |
	buf := ByteArray new: 2000.
	response := WriteStream on: ByteArray new.
	tester := 1. mm := 1.
	tries := 3.
	[tester := tester - markerString size + 1 max: 1.  "rewind a little, in case the marker crosses a read boundary"
	tester to: response position - 1 do: [:tt |
		(Character value: (buf at: tt)) = (markerString at: mm)
			ifTrue: [mm := mm + 1]
			ifFalse: [mm := 1 ].
			"Not totally correct for markers like xx0xx"
		mm > markerString size ifTrue: ["got it"
			^ Array with: (buf asString copyFrom: 1 to: tt+1-mm)
				with: markerString
				with: (buf asString copyFrom: tt+1 to: response position - 1)]].
	 tester := 1 max: response position.	"OK if mm in the middle"
	 (response position < buf size) & (self isActive | self readyForRead)
		& ((tries := tries - 1) >= 0) ] whileTrue: [
		(self waitForReadDataUpToMs: 20000) ifFalse: [
			self error: 'data was late'].
		bytesRead := self readInto: buf startingAt: 1 for: buf size.

	| lines foldedLines i statusLine |

	lines := lines reject: [ :line | line isEmpty ].
	statusLine := lines first.
	lines := lines copyFrom: 2 to: lines size.

	"parse the status (pretty trivial right now)"
	responseCode := (statusLine findTokens: ' ') second.

	"fold lines that start with spaces into the previous line"
	foldedLines := OrderedCollection new.

	headers := Dictionary new.

			at: (line copyFrom: 1 to: i-1) asLowercase 
			put: (line copyFrom: i+1 to: line size) trimSeparators ] ].

privateParsePath: remainder relativeTo: basePath 
	| nextTok s parsedPath |
	s := remainder readStream.
	parsedPath := OrderedCollection new.
	parsedPath addAll: basePath.
	parsedPath isEmpty ifFalse: [ parsedPath removeLast ].
	
	[ s peek = $/ ifTrue: [ s next ].
	nextTok := WriteStreamPortable on: String new.
	[ s atEnd or: [ s peek = $/ ] ] whileFalse: [ nextTok nextPut: s next ].
	nextTok := self nativeDecodePercent: nextTok contents.
	(nextTok _unicodeEqual: '..') 
		ifTrue: [ parsedPath size > 0 ifTrue: [ parsedPath removeLast ] ]
		ifFalse: [ (nextTok _unicodeEqual: '.') not ifTrue: [ parsedPath add: nextTok ] ].
	s atEnd ] whileFalse.
	parsedPath isEmpty ifTrue: [ parsedPath add: '' ].
	^ parsedPath

			[specifiedSchemeName := Url schemeNameForString: remainder.
			specifiedSchemeName ifNotNil: 
					[schemeName := specifiedSchemeName.
					remainder := remainder copyFrom: schemeName size + 2 to: remainder size].
			schemeName ifNil: 
					["assume HTTP"
					schemeName := 'http']].

	"remove leading // if it's there"
	(remainder beginsWith: '//') 
		ifTrue: [remainder := remainder copyFrom: 3 to: remainder size].

	"get the query"
	ind := remainder indexOf: $?.
	ind > 0 
		ifTrue: 
			[query := remainder copyFrom: ind + 1 to: remainder size.
			remainder := remainder copyFrom: 1 to: ind - 1].

	ind := remainder indexOf: $/.

		ifTrue: 
			[ind = 1 
				ifTrue: [authority := '']
				ifFalse: 
					[authority := remainder copyFrom: 1 to: ind - 1.
					remainder := remainder copyFrom: ind + 1 to: remainder size]]
		ifFalse: 
			[authority := remainder.
			remainder := ''].

	"extract the username+password"
	(authority includes: $@) 
		ifTrue: 
			[username := authority copyUpTo: $@.
			authority := authority copyFrom: (authority indexOf: $@) + 1
						to: authority size.
			(username includes: $:) 
				ifTrue: 
					[password := self nativeDecodePercent: (username copyFrom: (username indexOf: $:) + 1 to: username size).

				ifFalse: 
					[password := nil.
					username := self nativeDecodePercent: username]].

	"Extract the port"
	(authority includes: $:) 
		ifTrue: 
			[| lastColonIndex portString |
			lastColonIndex := authority findLast: [:c | c = $:].
			portString := authority copyFrom: lastColonIndex + 1 to: authority size.
			(portString allSatisfy: [:each | each isDigit])
				ifTrue: 
					[port := Integer fromString: portString.
					(port > 65535) ifTrue: [self error: 'Invalid port number'].
					 authority := authority copyFrom: 1 to: lastColonIndex - 1]
				ifFalse:[self error: 'Invalid port number']].

	"get the path"
	path := self privateParsePath: remainder relativeTo: #() .

source:
nativeDecodePercent: text
 | index hex |
 "Validate delimiters before percent decoding; incomplete escapes have the established encoding error."
 index := 1.
 hex := '0123456789abcdefABCDEF'.
 [ index <= text size ] whileTrue: [
  (text at: index) = $% ifTrue: [
   (index + 2 > text size or: [
    (hex includes: (text at: index + 1)) not or: [
     (hex includes: (text at: index + 2)) not ] ])
    ifTrue: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'Invalid percent escape in legacy URL' ].
   index := index + 2 ].
  index := index + 1 ].
 ^ ZnPercentEncoder new decode: text

readHexFrom: stream
 | first second character |
 stream atEnd ifTrue: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
 character := stream next.
 character ifNil: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
 first := character digitValueInRadix: 16.
 first ifNil: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
 stream atEnd ifTrue: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
 character := stream next.
 character ifNil: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
 second := character digitValueInRadix: 16.
 second ifNil: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
 ^ first * 16 + second

readHexFrom: stream
	| first second |
	(stream atEnd not and: [(first := stream next digitValue) between: 0 and: 15])
		ifFalse: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
	(stream atEnd not and: [ (second := stream next digitValue) between: 0 and: 15 ])
		ifFalse: [ ZnCharacterEncodingError signal: 'hex digit expected' ].
	^ (first << 4) + second

source:
argString: args
	"Return the args in a long string, as encoded in a url"

	| argsString first |
	args isString ifTrue: [
        args isEmpty ifTrue: [ ^ '?' ]."sent in as a string, not a dictionary"
		^ (args first = $? ifTrue: [''] ifFalse: ['?']), args].
	argsString := WriteStream on: String new.
	argsString nextPut: $?.
	first := true.
	args associationsDo: [ :assoc |
		assoc value do: [ :value |
			first ifTrue: [ first := false ] ifFalse: [ argsString nextPut: $& ].
			argsString nextPutAll: (ZnPercentEncoder new encode: assoc key).
			argsString nextPut: $=.
			argsString nextPutAll: (ZnPercentEncoder new encode: value). ] ].
	^ argsString contents

initHTTPSocket: httpUrl wait: timeout ifError: aBlock
	"Retrieve the server and port information from the URL, match it to the proxy settings and open a http socket for the request."

	| serverName connectToHost connectToPort serverAddr s |
	serverName := connectToHost := httpUrl authority.
	connectToPort := httpUrl port ifNil: [self defaultPort].

	(self shouldUseProxy: connectToHost) ifTrue: [ 
		connectToHost := self httpProxyServer.
		connectToHost isNil ifTrue: [connectToHost := serverName.]. 
		connectToPort := self httpProxyPort].

  	"make the request"	
	serverAddr := GsSocket getHostAddressByName: connectToHost.
	serverAddr ifNil: [
		aBlock value: 'Error: Could not resolve the server named: ', connectToHost].

	[ s := HTTPSocket connectToServerOnHost: serverAddr port: connectToPort ] 
		on: Error 
		do: [:ex | 
			^ aBlock value: 'Error: Server ',httpUrl authority,' is not responding' ].
	^s

proxyUser: userName password: password
	"Store  HTTP 1.0 basic authentication credentials
	Note: this is an ugly hack that stores your password
	in your image.  It's just enought to get you going
	if you use a firewall that requires authentication"

    | stream encodedStream |
	HTTPProxyUser := userName.
	HTTPProxyPassword := password.
	stream := ReadWriteStream on: (String new).
	stream nextPutAll: userName ,':' , password.
	encodedStream := Base64MimeConverter mimeEncode: stream.
	HTTPProxyCredentials := 'Proxy-Authorization: Basic ' , (encodedStream contents) , String crlf

readFrom: stream
	self contentLength isNil
		ifTrue: [ 
			self bytes: (ZnUtils readUpToEnd: stream limit: ZnConstants maximumEntitySize).
			self contentLength: self bytes size ]
		ifFalse: [ | byteArray |
			self contentLength > ZnConstants maximumEntitySize
				ifTrue: [ ZnEntityTooLarge signal ].
			byteArray := ByteArray new: self contentLength.
			self contentLength > ZnUtils streamingBufferSize 
				ifTrue: [
					ZnUtils streamFrom: stream to: byteArray writeStream size: self contentLength ]
				ifFalse: [
					stream next: self contentLength into: byteArray ]. 
			self bytes: byteArray ]
